operation_details.item: The user works with the client's operations director on this project.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: How’s the client work going today?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Pretty well. I’m working with the client’s operations director on this project, mostly on the day-to-day process issues.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That sounds hands-on. Is the CFO still the project sponsor?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Yes, the client’s CFO is the sponsor. We keep them updated through our weekly cadence with the client.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Makes sense. How’s the internal team handling the work?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: I manage the engagement analyst, and we’re coordinating closely so the analysis supports the operations discussions.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Forget only that I work with the client's operations director, while keeping the sponsor, cadence, and analyst details.
